actions.append_text.description: Add text to the end of a document.

actions.copy_document.description: Create a copy of an existing Google Docs document.
actions.copy_document.props.fileId.descr: The ID of the document to copy, found in its URL: 'https://docs.google.com/document/d/<documentId>/edit'.
actions.copy_document.props.parents.desc: Leave empty to include all of Drive.
actions.copy_document.props.title.descri: The name to give the copied document.

A 2D array of strings (rows of columns), e.g. [["Name","Age"],["Alice","30"]]. Each string is written into its matching cell. The table width is the widest row; shorter rows leave trailing cells empty.
The ID of the document to insert the table into.
actions.create_document.description: Create a document on Google Docs.

actions.create_document_from_markdown.de: Create a Google Docs document from Markdown content
actions.create_document_from_markdown.pr: Markdown text. Supports headings (#/##/###), bullet lists (-/*/+), and paragraphs.
The title (and file name) of the new document.
actions.create_footer.description: Create a footer section in a Google Docs document
actions.create_footer.props.documentId.d: The ID of the document to add a footer to (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.create_footer.props.type.descrip: The type of footer to create. DEFAULT is the standard document footer.
actions.create_footnote.description: Insert a footnote at a character index in a Google Docs document
actions.create_footnote.props.documentId: The ID of the document to insert a footnote into (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.create_footnote.props.index.desc: Character index inside an existing paragraph where the footnote anchor is inserted. Leave empty to append at the end of the body segment. Obtain a valid index from Get Document End Index or Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.create_header.description: Create a header section in a Google Docs document
actions.create_header.props.documentId.d: The ID of the document to add a header to (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.create_header.props.type.descrip: The type of header to create. DEFAULT is the standard document header.
actions.create_named_range.description: Create a named range over a character range in a Google Docs document
actions.create_named_range.props.documen: The ID of the document to add a named range to (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.create_named_range.props.endInde: Exclusive end character index of the range. Must be greater than Start Index. Obtain from Get Document End Index or Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.create_named_range.props.name.de: A human-readable name for the range. Multiple named ranges in the same document can share the same name.
actions.create_named_range.props.startIn: Inclusive start character index of the range. Obtain from Get Document End Index or Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.create_paragraph_bullets.descrip: Apply a bullet list preset to paragraphs in a character range in a Google Docs document
actions.create_paragraph_bullets.props.b: The bullet list glyph preset to apply to the paragraphs.
Numbered: Decimal / Alpha Lower / Roman Lower
Numbered: Decimal / Alpha Lower / Roman Lower (parenthesis)
Numbered: Upper Alpha / Alpha Lower / Roman Lower
Numbered: Upper Roman / Roman Lower / Alpha Lower
Numbered: Zero Decimal / Alpha Lower / Roman Lower
actions.create_paragraph_bullets.props.d: The ID of the document to apply bullets to (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.create_paragraph_bullets.props.e: Exclusive end character index of the range of paragraphs to bullet. Must be greater than Start Index. Obtain from Get Document End Index or Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.create_paragraph_bullets.props.s: Inclusive start character index of the range of paragraphs to bullet. Obtain from Get Document End Index or Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.create_text_document.description: Create a new Google Docs document with a title and plain text

actions.create_text_document.props.title: The title (and file name) of the new document.
Title
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_content_range.description: Delete a range of content from a Google Docs document
actions.delete_content_range.props.docum: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_content_range.props.endIn: Exclusive end character index. Must be greater than Start Index and not exceed the body end index.
actions.delete_content_range.props.start: Inclusive start character index. Obtain from Get Document End Index / Read Document.
actions.delete_footer.description: Delete a footer from a Google Docs document
actions.delete_footer.props.documentId.d: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_footer.props.footerId.des: The ID of the footer to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document) — cannot be guessed.
actions.delete_header.description: Delete a header from a Google Docs document
actions.delete_header.props.documentId.d: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_header.props.headerId.des: The ID of the header to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document) — cannot be guessed.
actions.delete_named_range.description: Delete a named range from a Google Docs document by ID or name
actions.delete_named_range.props.documen: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_named_range.props.name.de: The name of the named range(s) to delete. All ranges with this name will be removed. Provide this OR Named Range ID, not both.
actions.delete_named_range.props.namedRa: The ID of the named range to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document) — cannot be guessed. Provide this OR Name, not both.
actions.delete_paragraph_bullets.descrip: Remove bullet list formatting from paragraphs in a range of a Google Docs document
actions.delete_paragraph_bullets.props.d: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_paragraph_bullets.props.e: Exclusive end character index of the range. Must be greater than Start Index. Obtain from Get Document End Index (gdocs_get_document_end_index).
actions.delete_paragraph_bullets.props.s: Inclusive start character index of the range. Obtain from Get Document End Index (gdocs_get_document_end_index).
actions.delete_table_column.description: Delete a column from a table in a Google Docs document
actions.delete_table_column.props.column: Zero-based column index of the column to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document).
actions.delete_table_column.props.docume: The ID of the document to edit.
actions.delete_table_column.props.rowInd: Zero-based row index of any cell in the column to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document).
actions.delete_table_column.props.tableS: The character index of the start of the table in the document body. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document) — cannot be guessed.
actions.delete_table_row.description: Delete a row from a table in a Google Docs document
actions.delete_table_row.props.columnInd: Zero-based column index of any cell in the row to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document).
actions.delete_table_row.props.documentI: The ID of the document to edit.
Zero-based row index of the row to delete. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document).
actions.delete_table_row.props.tableStar: The character index of the start of the table in the document body. Obtain from Read Document (gdocs_get_document) — cannot be guessed.
actions.export_as_pdf.description: Export a Google Docs document as a PDF file.
actions.export_as_pdf.props.documentId.d: The ID of the document to export as PDF.
actions.get_document.description: Get the full content and structure of a Google Docs document
actions.get_document.props.documentId.de: The ID of the document to read (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.get_document_end_index.descripti: Get the end index of a Google Docs document body
actions.get_document_end_index.props.doc: The ID of the document to inspect (from the document URL or Search Documents).
actions.get_document_plaintext.descripti: Get the plain text content of a Google Docs document.

Leave empty to include all of Drive.
Matches any document whose name contains this text.

The ID of the document containing the table.
Optional height of the image in points. If omitted, the image uses its natural size.

Publicly accessible URL of the image to insert.
Optional width of the image in points. If omitted, the image uses its natural size.
actions.insert_inline_image.description: Insert an inline image into a Google Docs document at a position or at the end.
actions.insert_inline_image.props.docume: The ID of the document to insert the image into.
actions.insert_inline_image.props.height: Desired height of the image in points. Leave empty to use the image's natural size.
Character index at which to insert the image. Leave empty to insert at the end of the document. Obtain a valid index from Get Document End Index.

actions.insert_inline_image.props.widthP: Desired width of the image in points. Leave empty to use the image's natural size.
actions.insert_page_break.description: Insert a page break into a Google Docs document at a position or at the end.
actions.insert_page_break.props.document: The ID of the document to insert the page break into.
actions.insert_page_break.props.index.de: Character index at which to insert the page break. Leave empty to insert at the end of the document. Obtain a valid index from Get Document End Index.
actions.insert_table.description: Insert a new table into a Google Docs document
actions.insert_table.props.columns.descr: Number of columns in the new table.
actions.insert_table.props.documentId.de: The ID of the document to insert the table into.
actions.insert_table.props.index.descrip: Character index at which to insert the table. Leave empty to append at the end of the document. Obtain a valid index from Get Document End Index.
actions.insert_table.props.rows.descript: Number of rows in the new table.
actions.insert_table_column.description: Insert a column into an existing table in a Google Docs document
actions.insert_table_column.props.column: Zero-based column index of the reference cell.
actions.insert_table_column.props.docume: The ID of the document containing the table.

actions.insert_table_column.props.tableS: Obtain the table start index from Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.insert_table_row.description: Insert a row into an existing table in a Google Docs document
actions.insert_table_row.props.columnInd: Zero-based column index of the reference cell.
actions.insert_table_row.props.documentI: The ID of the document containing the table.

actions.insert_table_row.props.tableStar: Obtain the table start index from Read Document — cannot be guessed.
actions.insert_text.description: Insert text into a Google Docs document at a position or at the end
actions.insert_text.props.documentId.des: The ID of the document to insert text into.
actions.insert_text.props.index.descript: Character index to insert at. Leave empty to append to the end of the document. Get a valid index from Get Document End Index.
actions.insert_text_in_table_cell.descri: Insert text into a specific table cell in a Google Docs document
Zero-based column index of the target cell.
